notes.title: #2 Petmate v0.3.3 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Update Announcement
We still received a lot of feedback this week and have been fixing and optimizing it. Come see what improvements we've made this week and what features we've come up with that people want!


New Features
Go live with goodwill levels. This will play a very important role in the regular content updates that will follow.
Fixes[olist]
Fix the bug that buff stacking has no upper limit

Fix the bug of unlimited opening activities from buffs.

Fix the bug that wishes can be completed even if they have expired.

Fix the bug that the display of buff attributes exceeds the text box.
[/olist]Adjustment
Adjusted the gain of some buffs and the probability of getting buffs.
Next Update | Daisy whispered to you...
Time flies ~ In a flash, Petmate will be online for almost a month! During these days, the masters have been fulfilling Daisy's wishes every day, and their favorability has been rising a little bit.

Next update: We'll be launching an \[Intimate Communication Feature] 💬 When Daisy's favorability towards her owner is high enough, you'll be able to unlock more conversations just between you.

notes.title: #1 0.3.2 minor version update
notes.notes:
This update is a fixed update for the second week of every month developed to fix bugs and optimize the game experience.  We have collected a lot of feedback from the group and fixed and optimized these feedbacks for the main content of this update:  
[olist]
Fixed the problem of the Wish display box getting stuck  

Fixed the problem that items and activities in the Wish cannot be completed in the game.  

Fixed the problem of activity countdown display abnormality  

Optimized the values of some items and activities, and added a new activity that can restore part of your energy.  

Optimized the part of conversation in Wish, no longer can only have voice conversation, now can also have text conversation.  

Optimized setting saving, the next time you start the game, the settings will automatically follow the previous settings.  

Optimized the background image in the text chat box  

Optimized the content of Daisy's friend circle, now Daisy no longer only posts at 10:00, we leave the decision of posting time to Daisy, without any intervention. 

 Optimized the operation of store purchase, now you can buy items in bulk, maximum 99 items at one time.  

Optimized the operation of item usage, now you can double-click the item to use it directly, instead of right-clicking the item and then clicking to use it. 

Optimized the display of wishes, now you can see which part of the wish is not completed and which part is completed.  



Thank you all for your support and love! After that, our main update direction is the goodwill gameplay, nurturing, dialog fusion and Daisy's voice related content. We hope you enjoy Petmate!  
[/olist]
